I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message: the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging is **ticket #88412**.

He raised it himself as a Tier 2 support escalation in #central-team on 2 Jul 2025, a channel he's in. The tablet froze on the bill of lading (BOL) barcode scan. Their night shift lead said it hung when a Quarendon Freightways driver showed up with a split manifest.

I didn't find any later status update on that ticket in channels he can see.
